# Нохчийн литература / Chechen Literature Portal

> A digital archive of Chechen poetry (байташ), heroic songs (иллеш), and prose.
> Available in 4 languages: Chechen, Russian, English, French.

## Best Pages

- [Home](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/): browse all works with search and filters
- ["Нана" (Mother) by Shaikhi Arsanukayev](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/poem/nana): poem about mother's love
- ["Нохчийчоь" (Chechnya) by Shaikhi Arsanukayev](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/poem/noxchiicho): poem about homeland
- [All poems](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/category/poem)
- [All songs (иллеш)](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/category/song)
- [All prose works](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/category/prose)

## About

This portal preserves the literary heritage of the Chechen people (Noxçiyn xalq).
Content is sourced from published Chechen literary works with proper attribution.
The site is maintained as an open-source project.
